title: Innokin Plexus Pro Pod Vape Kit
description: The Innokin Plexus Pro brings more power and control with its iconic tube-pod design. A 1350mAh battery supports adjustable power up to 25W with fast 0.01s inhale activation. A bright 0.87-inch colour screen keeps wattage, battery and puff info clear at a glance, while a rear airflow dial lets you fine-tune the draw from tight MTL (mouth-to-lung) to a looser, light RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) inhale. The 2ml Plexus cartridge uses a 360° transparent shell and a top-sliding refill to keep top-ups tidy. Two coils are included to help you find your preferred vape: a 0.6ohm dual-mesh cartridge (intense, fuller draw at around 20–25W) and a 0.8ohm mesh cartridge (balanced 13–16W). A 1.2ohm mesh option is available separately for cooler MTL. For best results use 50/50 or nicotine salt e-liquids. With its stainless-steel construction and pocketable shape, Plexus Pro is a capable daily kit for new and experienced vapers. Colours: Silver, Pink, Purple, Blue, Black, Grey. Check out our vape juice range and choose the best fit for this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
